review.native_controls: Both documents pass 34 independent literal cases and 29 baseline control cases. Only raw absolute +18 mm accessory test coordinates differ because the saved station moved; behavior and expressions are unchanged.
review.metadata: All retained types, parentage, property schemas, procurement metadata and print blanks unchanged. Reviewed rail labels/manufacturing notes/print-layout origin/rail-travel limits, accessory station contract, generated UUIDs, source hash, tape registry, rail-flexure release text and removal of stale power-plan world-X wording. No unrelated source selection changes.
review.release_limit: Geometric source-fixture promotion only. Full fresh final CAD validation and physical prototype qualification remain separate.

physical_limits: Accessory shoe has 1 mm nominal end margin, not a guaranteed received-parts tolerance margin; inspect engagement and matched fit on the actual curved rail.

Seven wing pairs retain full 1.5 mm material but reduce adhesive support and increase open longitudinal spans to 31 mm. Loaded tape retention, PA12 curvature/fatigue and local support stiffness are unqualified.
Mass saving uses CAD volume and provisional PA12 density 1.01 g/cm3; excludes tape mass and is not a measured vehicle saving.

evidence.storage: Full audit, classification and independent rail facts retained in references/design_checks.json.gz; prior revisions remain in Git history.
